_help: Vetted clips from the client's Drive library (and our own Higgsfield renders). Use 'id' directly as a segment 'src' in remix/storyboard/premium specs: recut.source() downloads Drive ids in safe 1 MB chunks and caches them; https URLs are read directly. 'good' lists start times (s) of usable moments. 'mute': the clip's own audio is unusable. 'intros': real-customer clips: the narrator's line before her clip in a storyboard (the script reason for a second voice; brand voice, never a claim she didn't make). 'transcript': the committed transcript's name when it isn't the key. Transcripts: pipeline/data/transcripts/<name>_words.json (copy next to the downloaded file as <file>_words.json for remix.py).
